ac1.objective: Explain what a Node holds that a bare state does not — the parent pointer chain, the action that produced this node, the accumulated path_cost, and the depth — and how node.solution() uses the parent chain to reconstruct the ordered action sequence from root to goal. Explain also that node.path_cost holds the total cost, so you do not need to recompute it after search returns.
ac1.original_prompt: A search function hands you a goal Node. Describe what that Node carries beyond the raw state, when each of those values is set, and what you get back when you call solution() on it.

gaps.claim: path_cost and depth are recalculated later by the search algorithm rather than during expansion when the child Node is created.
